# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_WITH_RSI_BOUNCE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

During an intraday uptrend (price above a rising VWAP), a pullback to VWAP coupled with an RSI‑oversold bounce provides a high‑probability long entry. The edge exists because mean‑reversion to VWAP is strongest in the morning session (09:30‑11:30) and RSI‑oversold conditions often precede short‑term bounces in trending markets, especially when confirmed by bullish engulfing candles.

## Mechanism

Entry: Require price > VWAP and VWAP slope positive (VWAP > VWAP 5 bars ago); RSI(14) < 30; a bullish engulfing candle (close > open and body > prior bar body); enter at the close of that bar. Exit: Chart‑stop at the low of the entry bar, TP1 at 1R, runner trail using a chandelier exit (ATR*3). Regime filter: Only active during 09:30‑11:30 ET and when VIX is between 12‑22.
